preconditions.description: The number of participants m and the number of top results n must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= points[i] <= 2 * m for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each of the n integers representing the points must be non-negative and not exceed 2 * m.
The number of points provided must exactly match the value of n.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'no' or start with 'yes' followed by m lines describing the tournament results.
Each line of the tournament results must have 'X' on the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][j] in {'W', 'D', 'L'} for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j)
postconditions.description: Each off-diagonal character in the tournament results must be 'W', 'D', or 'L'.
